news.title: GFI launches the Biological AI Research Program
news.excerpt: Genomic Foresight Institute announces a new interdisciplinary research program focused on foundation models and representation learning for biological systems.

news.title: New framework for single-cell representation learning
news.excerpt: The Single-Cell Systems program releases a new computational framework for learning representations from single-cell data.

news.title: GFI announces Research Fellowship Program
news.excerpt: Applications are open for GFI Research Fellowships in computational biology, biological AI, and brain science.

news.title: Open Science initiative expands
news.excerpt: GFI commits to publishing all research software, models, and datasets under open-source licenses.
